body:
Thoughtfully curated by Heather, this ritual kit is crafted to clear emotional blockages, dissolve negativity, and reconnect you with your inner radiance. Whether you’re feeling emotionally drained, carrying resentment, or simply stuck in old patterns, this ritual transforms emotional heaviness into light, confidence, and self-love.

What’s Inside (and Why We Chose Them)

This kit is infused with powerful energies to help you release, heal, and glow up:

  • Pink Candle & Holder – For emotional healing and to light up your heart.
  • Pink Matches – To ignite your intention and carry the energy of love into your ritual.
  • Rose Petals & Salt Vial – For emotional purification, cleansing negativity, and releasing emotional blocks
  • Orris Root & Herb Blend (Rosemary & More) – To amplify love, emotional release, and beauty energy.
  • Pink Girasol in Energy Muse Mesh Bag – A high-vibrational crystal programmed to enhance emotional clarity, amplify intentions, and manifest love.
  • Dissolvable Paper – For setting your heart’s deepest wish and manifesting from a place of love.
  • Rose Oil – To anchor your intention and carry the vibration of love throughout your day.

Who Needs This Kit?

This is for you if…

  • You’re feeling emotionally drained, overwhelmed, or just “off.”
  • You’re carrying resentment, bitterness, or need to release past emotional pain.
  • You’ve lost your sparkle and need a powerful emotional reset.
  • You’re ready to reclaim your confidence, radiance, and step into your power.

Perfect for:

  • After a breakup, emotional setback, or any moment that diminished your light.
  • During Venus Retrograde or other cosmic periods when emotions run high.
  • When you’re feeling stuck in old patterns, negative thoughts, or self-doubt.
  • Whenever you need an emotional detox and a fresh start.
